summary: RETEST of the iteration 6 fixes. All of them pass. Backend: pytest tests/ -n 0, 34/34 pass. FIX 1: I loaded /pesanan-baru directly with no app history and saved a reseller order. It went to /dashboard and the form unmounted. pesananReseller went from 2 to 3, so only one order was created. Batal and the header back (screen-back) also go to /dashboard on a direct load. FIX 2: when I opened hist-edit-TEST_pr1 from /reseller, reseller-terpilih showed TEST_Reseller Satu. reseller-ganti and reseller-search were not shown and the toggle was disabled. Saving went back to /reseller and the count stayed the same, so no duplicate. FIX 3: with harga 18000, ongkir 15000 and karantina 5000, tapping the link set transfer to 38000 and the link hid. Switching to COD showed it again; tapping it gave 23000 and it hid again. Switching back to non-COD showed it again, giving 38000. Regression: a normal order from fab-pesanan-baru saved, the page went back to /dashboard, and pesanan went from 5 to 6. Browser back after the save does not reopen the form. Seeds were restored at the end.
